I wrote `BRIEF.md`. Key finding worth highlighting: three of the four source packets have a stated "summary" figure that doesn't match their own raw data, so I computed from raw data instead:

- **Finance:** spend line items sum to $464,000, not the stated $463,250 (off by $750)
- **Support:** 1,171/1,250 closed = 93.7%, not the stated 96.4%
- **Delivery:** walking the phase durations + Oct 12 holiday gives a launch date of 2026-10-23, not the stated 2026-10-22
- **Security:** 76/80 = 95.0% — this one actually matches its stated figure

I flagged all of this in the Notes section as a data-integrity item worth escalating, since the dashboards appear to be drifting from source data in three out of four cases.
